title: ZTAS-DTh: code and data for a zero-trust security architecture for the digital thread (v1.2.0)
description:
Code, configurations, random seeds, raw and processed data, executed notebooks, bounded model-checking logs, a single-host software proof of concept and its test results accompanying the manuscript ZTAS-DTh: A Lifecycle-Spanning Zero-Trust Security Architecture for the Digital Thread — Design, Bounded Formal Analysis, and Simulation-Based Evaluation.

v1.2.0 adds the third-revision package (revision_v1.2.0/ZTAS-DTh_v1.2.0_revision_package.zip), which contains everything in v1.1.0 plus: risk-engine robustness to measurement noise, missing signals (four imputation rules), adversarial signal withholding and attack intensity; an evidence-policy extension (thresholds 1–5, approval delay, emergency isolation, safe-state transition, propagation-aware threshold; four attacker profiles); legitimate false-isolation cost over all 850 joint-sensitivity points; ranking stability over 270 graphs; models M4f–g (check-to-enforce races) with negative controls (32 checks in total); proof-of-concept v4 with an enforcement-time re-check and race tests T-J and T-K; deterministic re-execution of archived tasks; an experiment evidence manifest; the revised manuscript (v4), supplementary material, response to reviewers and a SHA-256 manifest of every file.

Scope: all control-effectiveness probabilities are modelling assumptions, all risk-score distributions are synthetic, benchmarks were measured on a shared server VM, and no industrial measurement or deployment is included.
